verdict.line: You lose if you trade freely into Reckless Swing stacks or engage into an up Ragnarok; you win if you force all-ins at levels 3-5 and again post-6 whenever his R is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Olaf's E (Reckless Swing) is true damage to both of you, so stacking armor doesn't make trading into him free the way it does against most top laners. Worse, his R (Ragnarok) grants immunity to all disables, which directly no-sells the two abilities your whole kit is built around — E (Facebreaker)'s stun and R (The Show Stopper)'s suppression grab simply fail to lock him down while it's active. This matchup is decided by whether you fight on your cooldown timers or his.

theirWindow.what: Do not commit E (Facebreaker) or R (The Show Stopper) — both fail against his CC immunity and he gets bonus attack speed to punish the whiff. Poke with Q (Knuckle Down) and autos only, and bait the ult out with a half-commit before going in.

yourWindow.what: This is when your grab actually lands. Full commit: W (Haymaker) for the shield and slow, E (Facebreaker) into a wall for the stun, empowered Grit auto, then R (The Show Stopper) to close it out.

start.why: Sustain and early trade damage to survive Reckless Swing pokes before your stun combo is online.

boots.why: Blunts his Vicious Strikes attack-speed steroid and repeated Undertow/auto poke.

core.why: The movement speed and burst spellblade proc let you land the E-into-empowered-auto combo and stick through his Ragnarok speed boost.
The health bar and damage amp are your answer to his true damage — it doesn't get bypassed the way armor does.
Raw health plus the speed proc to close distance before he can kite with Ragnarok's attack speed.

situational.when: his Vicious Strikes lifesteal is winning extended trades or duels
he snowballs and his true damage plus sustain becomes unmanageable
he builds crit/attack speed and out-kites you after Ragnarok ends

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained stacking damage and heal-back matter more here than one burst window, since Olaf can just out-true-damage a single burst combo — Conqueror keeps you competitive across the whole extended trade.

summoners.why: Ignite directly cuts the Vicious Strikes/Reckless Swing lifesteal that lets him win extended trades, and secures the kill inside your levels 3-5 all-in window before his R comes online.

playing.title: Track his R cooldown, not just his health
playing.detail: Ragnarok makes your E and R whiff entirely. Never commit the grab combo while it's up — poke instead and wait him out.

playing.title: Don't auto-trade through Reckless Swing
playing.detail: His E is true damage on top of his own self-damage, meaning he's willing to burn health you can't mitigate with armor. Disengage rather than match autos.

playing.title: Land E into terrain
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if you throw him into a wall; without one he's just tossed behind you with zero CC applied.

playing.title: Watch for his axe on the ground
playing.detail: Undertow leaves a pickup axe that refunds cooldown — if it's still sitting there, his kit is running on longer timers and he's weaker to engage.

playing.title: Time all-ins to your Grit bar
playing.detail: Once the Grit meter under your health bar is full, your next auto becomes an empowered haymaker — hold the engage a half-second to land it inside the stun window.

playing.title: Don't Flash to chase during his ult
playing.detail: He's immune to slows and gets bonus attack speed during Ragnarok, so trying to stick with Flash just wastes it. Disengage and punish him after it ends instead.

playing.title: Force the level 3-5 kill lane
playing.detail: This is your clearest advantage window before his R exists — commit Ignite-backed all-ins here rather than passing up the lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect my last known patch and may have been renamed, reworked, or replaced since — check the in-client store and rune page before finalizing build. The core structural read (grab bruiser vs. true-damage CC-immune duelist) should hold regardless of specific item churn.
